designDecisions: POST /v1/boxes/prepare composes PrivateIntakeStore.request, IntentOrchestration.currentForRequest (requires approved, non-superseded, zero required-unresolved) and the registered repository row; repository snapshotId must equal the request snapshotId (missing_evidence otherwise).
Deterministic floor: supportedCaseId selects one of two literal descriptors in types.ts; the unsupported coupling label and any unknown id throw unsupported_case (422).

createPrepared/revisePrepared insert artifact+version(+head) atomically inside one transaction, reusing assertNoRestrictedFields, requirePermission and the existing idempotent key machinery; amend keeps the same intent provenance and invalidates prior approval (supersededApproval visible via read).

Registration imports the pinned snapshot, writes private_intake_objects/private_snapshots/private_snapshot_provenance and box_repository_registrations in one transaction; data-level idempotency via the unique (snapshot_id, base_commit, context_manifest_hash) key; operation keys reuse the 'create' op namespace with a kind discriminator.

Context manifest records per-file sha256/bytes/role (protected/explanatory/runnable/excluded), per-case runnable/explanatory/packageMap/dependencyVersions/runnableChecks, plannerExcludedPaths, initialCoupling and the structural environment/evaluator descriptors; environmentRef/evaluatorRef digests are sha256 of the descriptor JSON at registration time.

Agreement projection is a fresh Box-specific schema exposing boxId, version, state, repoId, snapshot/baseCommit, editableSurface, runnable/explanatory, packageMap, truths (helper-level HTTPS/non-localhost HSTS vs live-localhost no-HSTS), environment/evaluator refs, merge target, artifactHashes, approval, supersededApproval and blockingReasons.
Readiness opens only when artifact.unknowns is empty and an exact-hash approval exists for the current version; revising a Box with new unknowns blocks readiness (missing_evidence).
